steps: B's users pay 100× more for blockspace, a stronger sign of valuable activity.

scenes.q: Why are fees a better usage signal than transaction counts?
scenes.a: Paying fees shows real demand; counts are easy to inflate.
scenes.vo: Question one. Why are fees a better usage signal than transaction counts? [[pause 4]] The answer: Paying fees shows real demand; counts are easy to inflate.

scenes.vo: Question two. What distorts transaction counts? [[pause 4]] The answer: Bots, batching and chain design.
